react_native_issues.issue: Direct react-native-webview import bypasses the CrossWebView PWA shim. Reference: /app/frontend/app/share/[shareId].tsx:5

action_items: Swap `import { WebView } from "react-native-webview"` to `import { WebView } from "@/src/components/CrossWebView"` in /app/frontend/app/share/[shareId].tsx (line 5) so the public share route also works on the PWA build.
critical_code_review_comments: CrossWebView.tsx is well-designed: platform-gated dynamic require of react-native-webview only on native (line 76-85) prevents the web bundler from ever pulling in the native module. The <iframe srcDoc> path (WebViewWeb) injects a postMessage bridge so `window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage(...)` inside the HTML still delivers via window.parent.postMessage, and the outer React handler in useEffect filters by evt.source === iframe.contentWindow (line 26) to avoid cross-iframe leakage. Correct.

api.ts:317-336: geocode/reverseGeocode correctly try backend first (only if BASE), catch network-shaped errors via isNetworkError, and fall through to directNominatimSearch/Reverse. isNetworkError now recognises the 'no backend configured' sentinel (line 47) so the fallback fires for both empty-BASE builds and offline preview envs.

api.ts:56-62: req() short-circuits with `throw new Error("No backend configured")` before touching fetch when BASE is unset. Prevents accidental hits to `undefined/api/...` on a static Vercel deployment.
MISS: /app/frontend/app/share/[shareId].tsx still bypasses the shim (line 5). Same class of bug the user filed originally — the /share/{shareId} page will crash on a PWA build.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original bug: react-native-webview throws 'React Native WebView does not support this platform' when rendered on the `web` platform. The fix (CrossWebView shim + Nominatim fallback + friendlier auto-import error) resolves the two entry points the user hit — the trip Map tab (Map.tsx) and the pin picker (MapPickerModal.tsx) — plus makes the address-suggestion and reverse-geocode paths work with zero backend. Reproduction on the preview URL now shows: Map tab renders Leaflet tiles inside an iframe; LocationInput 'Paris' returns Nominatim/backend suggestions; auto-import 'Delta 456 JFK to CDG June 5 2027' produces a flight whose departure_location is 'John F. Kennedy International Airport, JFK Access Road, Queens, Queens County, New York, 11430, United States'. Remaining risk: the third WebView consumer /share/[shareId].tsx was NOT migrated to CrossWebView, so anyone opening a shared trip link on the Vercel PWA will still see the original error. Mitigation: single-line import swap (see action_items).
